actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 411 - 0 (Roll no. 89). (text: CR H1435-1436)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 411 - 0 (Roll no. 89). (text: CR H1435-1436: 1)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H1441-1442)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 586.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H1435-1437)
Mr. Bost moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended.
Referred to the Subcommittee on Health.
Referred to the House Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans who served in the Vietnam theater of operations, the VA, and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
dimensions.evidence: veterans who served in the Vietnam theater of operations during the Vietnam era

dimensions.assessment: Directs a health study, ongoing tracking, and periodic congressional reporting, along with a minor one-month extension of a pension payment limitation.
dimensions.evidence: commence an epidemiological study on the prevalence of cholangiocarcinoma

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state or imply specific federal spending allocations or revenue amounts for the study.
Mandates specific agency research, interagency consultation, registry tracking, reporting requirements, and a statutory amendment to a pension limitation date.
dimensions.evidence: Section 5503(d)(7) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking 'November 30, 2031' and inserting 'December 31, 2031'

dimensions.assessment: Requires initial studies, ongoing registry tracking, and periodic follow-up reports to Congress, with a permanent extension of a sunset date to December 31, 2031.
dimensions.evidence: periodically submit to the Congress a follow-up reports

missing_information: Specific cost estimates for conducting the epidemiological study.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the VA to conduct an epidemiological study on bile duct cancer prevalence in Vietnam-era veterans, report to Congress, track cases through its cancer registry, and slightly extend a pension payment limitation date.
